description: Verify that an empty echoUINT8 Request payload elicits a Response with stripped payload
approach:
[Objective]
Empty payload edge case: DUT must accept zero-length echo input and reply with a corresponding stripped (zero-length) payload.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Tester → DUT: Method Request (per-case shape).
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: Method Response (or absence) per the asserted behaviour.

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted response satisfies the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Fail_phase2_payload_not_stripped: DUT response payload was not stripped for short array
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_response: No Method Response within listen window
